title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Commerce…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Drupal Commerce Stripe versions 2.0.0 through 2.2.3 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This flaw could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by other users.
